MainGoal: Validate the solution using real UAE retailer data.
Actions: Connect sales data; validate product categories; deploy ABC prioritisation; run weekly forecasts for selected Category A products; compare forecasts with actual demand; build Power BI monitoring; gather staff feedback.
SuccessIndicators: Stable data pipeline; forecast accuracy monitored; dashboard used by pilot team; retailer assumptions validated.

MainGoal: Integrate forecasting and inventory logic into routine retail planning.
Actions: Connect supplier lead times and live inventory; expand forecasting to more products; include verified promotions, holidays and local events; automate dashboard refreshes; introduce reorder alerts.
SuccessIndicators: More SKUs covered; live inventory data connected; regular forecast refresh; replenishment alerts operational.

MainGoal: Scale the system across stores, channels or business units.
Actions: Automate model monitoring and retraining; support Arabic product data where required; integrate ERP/POS/WMS systems; test automated replenishment workflows; add exception-based manager review.
SuccessIndicators: System operates across broader assortment; automatic monitoring active; reduced manual planning workload; retailer-specific KPI improvements measured.
